summary: Sign-up form goes blank on Safari/Mac after clicking Continue with Google — Clerk Turnstile bot-check throws and wipes form
description:
Reported by a Mac Safari user: clicking Begin -> /sign-up appears blank.

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed live against prod, guru-ai.org, via a real WebKit repro):
Clerk Bot Protection is enabled on this instance (clerk.guru-ai.org/v1/environment: captcha_enabled=true, captcha_provider=turnstile, captcha_widget_type=smart, captcha_oauth_bypass=[] i.e. OAuth is NOT exempt). Clicking 'Continue with Google' on /sign-up triggers an embedded Cloudflare Turnstile challenge that:
  1. opens an iframe to challenges.cloudflare.com
  2. throws a same-origin JS error ('...challenges.cloudflare.com from accessing a frame with origin https://guru-ai.org. Protocols, domains, and ports must match.')
  3. the challenge-verification request 401s
  4. the SignUp form's DOM content (email field, password field, Google button) disappears afterward, leaving only the card header -- this is what reads as 'blank page'

No src/app/error.tsx or global-error.tsx exists anywhere in the tree, so nothing catches this and shows a retry state.

Turnstile's smart/managed mode is known to have elevated failure rates specifically under Safari privacy features (ITP, iCloud Private Relay) vs Chrome -- explains why this is Safari-specific in the field even though it also reproduces on generic WebKit.

SECONDARY, independent issue also found live: accounts.guru-ai.org (Clerk's Account Portal) currently returns HTTP 403 from Cloudflare with cf-mitigated: challenge on every request -- unrelated to the above but a real broken piece of the auth infra.

SUGGESTED FIX: in Clerk dashboard, add oauth_google to the CAPTCHA OAuth bypass list (Google's own OAuth already does bot verification, so gating it behind Turnstile too is redundant and is what's failing). Also add src/app/global-error.tsx as a general safety net regardless of root cause.

resolution.test_function: renders a visible fallback with a retry action instead of a blank page
resolution.note: Added src/app/global-error.tsx as the App Router's outermost error boundary — defense-in-depth so an uncaught client-side RENDER exception shows a visible fallback + retry instead of unmounting to a blank page. Note this is a React error boundary: it only catches errors thrown during render, so it is NOT guaranteed to catch the original Turnstile failure mode (async cross-origin pageerror + 401 fetch + Clerk's own SignUp DOM wipe). Does NOT fix the underlying trigger — the actual fix was disabling Clerk Bot sign-up protection in the dashboard (verified live: captcha_enabled=false). Boundary remains a general safety net regardless.

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: User disabled Bot sign-up protection entirely in the Clerk dashboard (broader than the suggested oauth_google-only bypass). Verified live: clerk.guru-ai.org/v1/environment now shows captcha_enabled=false, captcha_provider=null. Re-ran the WebKit repro against prod — clicking 'Continue with Google' on /sign-up now navigates straight to accounts.google.com's real sign-in screen with no Turnstile iframe, no cross-origin pageerror, and no form wipe. Root cause confirmed resolved end-to-end. global-error.tsx boundary from this PR remains as defense-in-depth regardless.

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: Correction to prior analysis entry: the 'CAPTCHA OAuth bypass' dashboard control I described does not exist. Clerk's dashboard only exposes a single global Bot sign-up protection toggle (confirmed via Clerk's own docs) -- the captcha_oauth_bypass field seen in the live API response is real but not dashboard-configurable. User disabled protection globally to unblock the Safari bug, and is not thrilled about the broader-than-needed scope. Left open as owner's call: re-enable globally, build a custom sign-up flow for granular control, or ask Clerk support about captcha_oauth_bypass. PR body corrected to match.
